title: Autoscale circuit buffer and ephemeral throttle patch for transient-surge smoothing
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: A recent incident showed rapid autoscaler oscillation combined with aggressive regional load-shedding can flip tenant circuits repeatedly for short surges, causing elevated tail latency and client-visible 5xx spikes. This PR introduces a short-lived autoscale circuit buffer and an ephemeral tenant throttle controller to smooth transient surges and prevent circuit thrashing. Motivation: reduce noisy reopen/close cycles for circuits, minimize KV drain races during fast failovers, and provide tighter telemetry for SLO enforcement windows. Summary of changes: 1) runtime/circuit/buffer: new in-memory short TTL buffer that holds recent circuit-state transitions and suppresses immediate reopen requests for a configurable damping window; 2) controlplane/throttle: ephemeral throttle controller that applies micro-throttles (soft rejects) for tenants that trigger >X circuit flips within Ys; throttles are non-persistent and decay exponentially; 3) autoscaler: small heuristic adjustment so the autoscaler consults buffer signals before aggressive scale-out decisions during high-frequency spikes; 4) kvsync: add KV-drain guard to avoid concurrent drain + reopen race that produced sticky circuit state in the incident; 5) telemetry: new metrics (circuit_buffer_suppressed, ephemeral_throttle_active, kv_guard_blocked_ops) and a dashboard tile; 6) tests: unit + integration tests for buffer hysteresis and throttle decay, and a small perf benchmark that runs 10k synthetic short spikes showing reduced reopen rate. Rollout plan: feature-gated behind runtime.feature_flags.experimental_circuit_buffer; enable in staging for 24h, then canary 5% traffic for 6h, then progressive ramp if no regressions. Monitoring / runbook: added runbook section with alert tuning (circuit_reopen_rate > 5/min for 5m) and recommended rollback steps. Backports: small patch backported to release-1.8 branch (see backport commit). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Perf benchmark - [x] Updated metrics and dashboard - [x] Runbook and rollout instructions Related: incident postmortem SUP-1192, previous PRs on circuit resilience. Risk: medium — touching circuit and autoscaler interactions; mitigations include flag gating, tight canary window, and conservative defaults.
